item.text:
Audited [hai-ibadat-husain-ka-matam.md](src/data/lyrics/hai-ibadat-husain-ka-matam.md). The Roman transliteration now aligns with all 63 Urdu verses and follows the source’s stanza boundaries. I supplied missing lines from the Urdu, corrected mismatched wording, and normalized Roman spellings. The Urdu body and other metadata were preserved.

I retained `Hajr-e-Aswad` for the source spelling `ہجرِ اسود`. Its intended pronunciation remains open for editorial review.
